verdicts.reason: A at least rearranges into a left-to-right banner, but the four-line headline is about 5px type and unreadable. The LIMITED EDITION badge overlaps the headline area, the can and logo are lost or tiny, and the CTA is small and competes with the stray AWARD WINNING badge. B is just the vertical original shrunk into the centre of the strip, with huge dead areas on both sides. Every element in B, including the headline, CTA and logo, is a few pixels tall and illegible, so it is unusable.
